chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The worst sin is that which the committer takes lightly.
ai.seo_question: What is the worst sin according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the gravest category of sin not by its magnitude in itself, but by the sinner's attitude, specifically when they consider it trivial. This reflects a spiritual hardening of the heart and a lack of reverence for God, a concept emphasized in Shia scholarship as the precursor to persistent sinfulness. The warning underscores that轻视 (taking lightly) of divine commands erodes the foundation of taqwa (God-consciousness).
